property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer(...) always returns true (completes successfully and yields true); the mutant returns false causing the return value to differ for inputs with _tos.length>0.
For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer(...) always returns true (call completes and returns true); the mutant returns false for some inputs, breaking this invariant.

For any inputs, C.transfer always returns true (it ignores callee failures and completes), whereas the mutant may return false if any low-level call fails — so the property is that transfer(...) never returns false; the mutant violates this for inputs where a callee call fails.
